title: Bsd Deficiency
objective: Certified deficient-place tests and conditional Poonen-Stoll Sha-shape diagnostics for genus-2/3 hyperelliptic Jacobians
references: Poonen--Stoll, The Cassels--Tate Pairing on Polarized Abelian Varieties, Theorem 11 and Corollary 12
Dokchitser--Dokchitser--Maistret--Morgan, Arithmetic of hyperelliptic curves over local fields, Theorem 12.4
Magma IsDeficient/HasIndexOne for genus-2 differential checks

oracles: exact Sturm and finite-field certificate replay

handoff.summary: Implemented replayable local deficiency certificates for genus-2/3 curves over QQ and exact global Poonen--Stoll parity assembly. Every v2 local/global record is recursively immutable, bound to the exact f/h curve model and SHA-256 fingerprint, and strictly deserializes only by recomputing its theorem. Supplied assertions remain unverified. Reduction-derived conclusions retain their full upstream certificate; mutable LocalReductionData is type-checked and replayed on a fresh curve before promotion. Global completion requires a typed, replayed exhaustive-bad-primes certificate, while the unconditional genus-3 degree-2 fibre theorem rejects contradictory inputs. The local envelope includes exact real genus-2 Sturm decisions, rational local-point/Hensel witnesses, good-reduction component witnesses, split-cluster and ordinary-nodal semistable witnesses, and odd-prime Poonen--Stoll Lemmas 15--16 including certified obstructions. Published examples agree at every recorded place with Magma IsDeficient; adversarial tests cover forged and cache-poisoned reductions, model/genus mismatches, mutation, serialized tampering, generalized h-model translations, and fixture drift. Integration owns public model bindings.
risks: Bad 2-adic places are certified only when an explicit local point witness is found; wild deficiency otherwise remains unsupported.
A nonsplit two-component ordinary-nodal certificate is left unsupported because current reduction data omits node thicknesses needed to replay Theorem 12.4 safely.
Almost-good cases use the exact Poonen--Stoll criteria on the normalized branch model; inconclusive exceptional-square cases remain unsupported.
Strict replay intentionally recomputes local/global reduction data and may be more expensive than merely parsing a serialized record; this is the certification boundary, not a cache-loading API.
The required repository-wide architecture, strict-baselib, and native gates are deliberately deferred to integration per coordination; focused source, type, runtime, and fixture receipts pass.
next_steps: Expose the frozen result objects and curve methods from the integration lane and include their modules in the repository strict-Pyright registry.
Attach the global deficiency diagnostic to the BSD result without inspecting or rounding the analytic quotient.
Enrich semistable certificates with cluster Frobenius orbits, epsilon signs, and node depths/thicknesses to implement the remaining Theorem 12.4 cases.
Extend the local engine to regular-model and certified wild 2-adic envelopes.
